create_SGD_optimizer: create an SGD optimizer with a learning rate and momentum for model parameters
create_SGD_with_nesterov: create an SGD optimizer with Nesterov momentum enabled for accelerated convergence
create_SGD_with_weight_decay: create an SGD optimizer with L2 weight decay regularization for model parameters
create_SGD_with_grad_threshold: create an SGD optimizer with gradient thresholding to prevent gradient explosion
run_SGD_step: run a single optimization step on the SGD optimizer to update model parameters
